# binance-sdk — full endpoint map

## Spot

- GET /api/v3/ping (PUBLIC) → spot.market.ping
- GET /api/v3/time (PUBLIC) → spot.market.serverTime
- GET /api/v3/exchangeInfo (PUBLIC) → spot.market.exchangeInfo
- GET /api/v3/depth (PUBLIC) → spot.market.depth
- GET /api/v3/trades (PUBLIC) → spot.market.trades
- GET /api/v3/historicalTrades (API_KEY) → spot.market.historicalTrades
- GET /api/v3/aggTrades (PUBLIC) → spot.market.aggTrades
- GET /api/v3/klines (PUBLIC) → spot.market.klines
- GET /api/v3/uiKlines (PUBLIC) → spot.market.uiKlines
- GET /api/v3/avgPrice (PUBLIC) → spot.market.avgPrice
- GET /api/v3/ticker/24hr (PUBLIC) → spot.market.ticker24hr
- GET /api/v3/ticker/price (PUBLIC) → spot.market.tickerPrice
- GET /api/v3/ticker/bookTicker (PUBLIC) → spot.market.bookTicker
- GET /api/v3/ticker (PUBLIC) → spot.market.rollingWindowTicker
- GET /api/v3/ticker/tradingDay (PUBLIC) → spot.market.tradingDayTicker
- POST /api/v3/order (SIGNED) → spot.trading.createOrder
- POST /api/v3/order/test (SIGNED) → spot.trading.testOrder
- GET /api/v3/order (SIGNED) → spot.trading.getOrder
- DELETE /api/v3/order (SIGNED) → spot.trading.cancelOrder
- DELETE /api/v3/openOrders (SIGNED) → spot.trading.cancelOpenOrders
- GET /api/v3/openOrders (SIGNED) → spot.trading.getOpenOrders
- GET /api/v3/allOrders (SIGNED) → spot.trading.getAllOrders
- POST /api/v3/order/cancelReplace (SIGNED) → spot.trading.cancelReplaceOrder
- POST /api/v3/orderList/oco (SIGNED) → spot.trading.createOCOOrder
- DELETE /api/v3/orderList (SIGNED) → spot.trading.cancelOCOOrder
- GET /api/v3/orderList (SIGNED) → spot.trading.getOCOOrder
- GET /api/v3/openOrderLists (SIGNED) → spot.trading.getOpenOCOOrders
- GET /api/v3/allOrderLists (SIGNED) → spot.trading.getAllOCOOrders
- DELETE /api/v3/openOrderLists (SIGNED) → spot.trading.cancelOpenOCOOrders
- GET /api/v3/account (SIGNED) → spot.trading.account
- GET /api/v3/myTrades (SIGNED) → spot.trading.myTrades
- GET /api/v3/myPreventedMatches (SIGNED) → spot.trading.myPreventedMatches
- GET /api/v3/account/commission (SIGNED) → spot.trading.accountCommission
- GET /api/v3/rateLimit/order (SIGNED) → spot.trading.rateLimitOrder
- POST /api/v3/userDataStream (API_KEY) → spot.userStream.createListenKey
- PUT /api/v3/userDataStream (API_KEY) → spot.userStream.keepAliveListenKey
- DELETE /api/v3/userDataStream (API_KEY) → spot.userStream.closeListenKey
